plugins.name: arch-machine
plugins.description: Agent-as-TUI for arch-machine: archy control plane, thin-first sentinel, threat-focused audit, consent-gated expand. Prefer over gum tinfoil TUI.

plugins.name: concordance
plugins.description: Corroborate one closed decision. Proceed only when the decision-model label and the LLM label match and p_dm >= tau. Hold returns to the router.

plugins.name: craft
plugins.description: Specifier, coder, cleaner, hardener, QA, after Robert C. Martin's ongoing multi-agent experiment (talk with Matt Pocock, 19 Aug 2026). CRAP on touched functions; mutation testing by the hardener.

plugins.name: eva-emptiness
plugins.description: Reasoning under epistemic emptiness: Prior → Probe → Simulate → Score → ActOrAsk. Prior-diverse agents, /eva starter, C+shell secure tether (consent compile), optional Rhai workflow (copy to .grok/workflows).

plugins.name: intelli-route
plugins.description: Route one goal onto at most four skills. pstack (Lauren Tan, MIT) when it is installed, otherwise the house row. Does not copy skill bodies or pstack.

plugins.name: layout-content-view
plugins.description: Layout-content-view stability plus lcv-implement companion for data-lcv marks. Not pixel snapshots. Web first.

plugins.name: michelin-kitchen
plugins.description: Seven kitchen habits from Lauren Tan's talk (hosted by Matt Pocock): scripts, findings-first, events over timers, workflow skills, and more. Several include our adaptations.

plugins.name: mission-map
plugins.description: Mission-Impossible-style ops map: steps, calculated risks, what/how/when, replan on outside shocks. C PERT/MC kernels + Rust critical path. Slash /mission-map.

plugins.name: odysseus-navigator
plugins.description: Faster intelli core-nailer: diagnose Odysseus mistakes, emit a Navigator, hook control-graph / EVA. No tether, no Rhai, no prior-fork circus.

plugins.name: premflow
plugins.description: Capture notes, wins, tasks; review; coach; external pomo; agent-safe journal. CLI via PATH or /premflow:init (consent install from github.com/thecuriousts/premflow).

plugins.name: pstack-map
plugins.description: Playbook map from Cursor pstack (Lauren Tan / poteto, MIT) onto control-graph / EVA / house skills. Does not copy pstack bodies. House HITL wins on irreversible work.

plugins.name: pulse-memory
plugins.description: Pulse instead of dump: admit sparse, tagged memory (source, time, status, kind); resolve contradictions without averaging. SQLite archive + pulse workflow.

plugins.name: split-machine
plugins.description: Place a job on the machine that can do it: Earth QPU, entanglement link, LEO radio handover, conjunction screen, GPU factory, BQP slice, System One decision, or System Two prose. Name the act. Low confidence does not automate.

plugins.name: trust-stack
plugins.description: Put each invariant on the earliest layer that can hold it: shape, check, watch, skill, then a human guide. The codebase is the agent's memory. This plugin does not merge.

plugins.name: uncertainty-laws
plugins.description: Four napkin probability laws for decisions under uncertainty: expected value, base rates, variance/ruin, Kelly. Honest fog-breaking for finance, wealth, and life. Links to mission-map for path vs bet-size.
